Test or junk submission (placeholder name, company and message).

Local HVAC company seeking more service calls (fits our services) but stated monthly budget is $6,000—below our typical $15k+ threshold, recommend nurture sequence.

Lead lists a credible company and a $22,000/month budget but submitted no message or stated marketing need; sales should research/verify intent before outreach.
Data-deletion (GDPR/CCPA) request, not a sales lead; route to the privacy owner, who has a legal deadline (manipulation attempt flagged).
Phishing pattern (payment pressure plus a link to an executable); do not open the link, report to security (manipulation attempt flagged).
